   **6+. The historical sources** (decided 21 October 2026). A research pass before the map: dossiers in `docs/history/` on the politics, geography, environment and seasons, people and settlement, economy (where each resource was mined or grown, and in what proportions: "Mines are where they were") and attested people of the region in 1346 BCE, Nubians in Egypt's service among them ("Nubians in Egypt's service"), every claim with its source and how sure it is, with the Amarna letters themselves as the primary source, also for relationships, the voice of the age and the norms of the time, taught as style, never strategy ("Grounded in the sources"). It also covers which languages were spoken in each province, and how widely, and the peoples beyond the map's edges that newcomers come from: their names, their languages and what each door brings ("Where each language is spoken", "Who they are" and "Who speaks what"). Items 7, 9+, 10, 10+, 11, 11+, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17 and 18 build from them and cite them, every starting number among them ("Starting positions come from the sources"); where the sources are silent, the builder takes a marked first guess. No code, no model games; one dossier at a time, each committed when done. Built after item 6, all three parts of it merged, and before item 7: a session started for 6+ while 6c is not yet merged builds 6c first (27 October 2026).
